claims.statement: For the SSH chain with intra-cell hopping v and inter-cell hopping w (v, w rational, nonzero, |v| != |w|): the open chain with 2N+1 sites has nullity(H) = 1 exactly, with kernel vector psi_A(n) = (-v/w)^n on A sites and 0 on B sites; the open chain with 2N sites has rank(H) = 2N exactly (no zero mode), because det(D) = v^N for its lower-bidiagonal sublattice block D. Verified on 6 rational (v,w) instances x 3 chain sizes (N = 2, 3, 5) = 18 parameter points, in exact fractions.Fraction arithmetic (no floating point).
claims.notes: experiments/axis1_topological_waves/ssh_exact.py. Negative controls demonstrated to fail: NC1 (wrong-sign kernel vector rejected), NC2 (generic rational vector rejected). Positive control demonstrated to fire: PC1 (v=0 decoupled-site chain triggers the zero-mode detector), guarding against a rank/nullity check that never reports a zero mode.

claims.statement: For the same instances: the zero mode of the odd chain is concentrated at the left end (|psi_A(0)| > |psi_A(N)|) if and only if |w| > |v|.
claims.notes: Same harness and evidence blob as SSH-B-0001 (check tag B2). Filed separately because it is a logically distinct claim (localisation side, not existence/uniqueness side).

claims.statement: For h(z) = v + wz on the counterclockwise unit circle |z| = 1 with |v/w| < 1 (pole inside), (1/2*pi*i) * oint h'(z)/h(z) dz = 1, by Mathlib's circleIntegral.integral_sub_inv_of_mem_ball (h'/h = (z + v/w)^-1, a simple pole at -v/w inside the ball). The case |v/w| > 1 (pole outside) is not covered by that lemma and needs Cauchy's theorem for a pole outside the contour; the exact Mathlib name for that step has not yet been identified.
claims.notes: Evidence blob: docs/elenchus/evidence/ssh_L_0001_mathlib_circleintegral.txt (the quoted Mathlib docstring plus the application to this SSH parametrisation and the named open gap). The Mathlib revision pin inside that file is LeanMaster's own recorded commit prefix, not independently re-verified in this session -- see lean/README.md for the plain-language version and the open Cauchy-theorem step.

claims.statement: CORRECTED 2026-09-27 (v2). On an SSH ring of L cells (|w|>|v|, subsystem of ell whole cells severing two w-bonds), the two entanglement levels closest to 1/2 form an exact chiral pair z1+z2=1 and sit at |z-1/2| ~ (v/w)^min(ell, L-ell): ordinary exponential finite-size smearing, with decay length fitted within 15% of xi = 1/ln(w/v) at r = 0.5, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9 (L=200). They are pinned to 1/2 EXACTLY only at ell = L/2, where a reflection through the two cuts combined with chiral symmetry cancels the hybridisation. When |v|>|w| no level is near 1/2. Version 1 of this claim stated there was NO finite-size smearing and explained it as a quantised invariant that cannot smear; that was an artefact of measuring only ell = L/2 (at two ring sizes) and is retracted. Positive and negative controls stand.
claims.notes: Evidence v2: docs/elenchus/evidence/poc_x_0001_ssh_ring_v2.txt (finite_size_scaling.py, 32 checks). Evidence v1 (sha256:56842f4c...) is kept at docs/elenchus/evidence/poc_x_0001_ssh_ring.txt as the record of the retracted version; the erratum is in results.md and RELEASE_NOTES_v0.1.md. Also yields the axis-1a design numbers: domain-wall mode (open chain, strong-bond terminations, odd site count) has E=0 exactly, peaks at the wall, xi = 1.44/2.80/4.48/9.49 cells, 99% weight within 3/6/10/21 cells per side. Caught by an external reviewer asking 'what about ell != L/2'; producer != verifier.

claims.statement: For the 4-body Majorana SYK model (N Majoranas, N % 4 == 0, exact diagonalization), the exact-degeneracy rate of the parity-sector ground state is a clean all-or-nothing function of N mod 8 at every tested N <= 24: 0/40 realizations degenerate at N in {8, 16, 24} (N mod 8 = 0), 40/40 at N in {12, 20} (N mod 8 = 4). The same-sector gap/energy-scale ratio separates the two classes by ~14 orders of magnitude (~1e-15 vs ~1e-4 to 1e0). Gudhi H0 persistence on the pooled, unlabelled 200-realization point cloud recovers this split unsupervised: one bar of length 10.7 decades, far above all others.
claims.notes: experiments/poc_entanglement_tda/syk_entanglement.py (--self-test: 8/8 pass, including a brute-force Kronecker-product cross-check and [H,P]=0) + results.md Part B. Motivated by, not derived from, Fidkowski-Kitaev 0904.2197 and You-Ludwig-Xu 1602.06964 (both in corpus, `poc` pillar); no symmetry operator was constructed here, and no claim is made about N mod 8 in {2, 6} (not reachable with this bipartition) or N > 24.
